<?php

class FeatureFlags {
    private $flags = [];
    private $defaults = [
        'resize_enabled' => true,
        'watermark_enabled' => false,
        'max_width' => 1920,
        'max_height' => 1080,
        'quality' => 85,
        'allowed_formats' => ['jpg', 'png', 'webp']
    ];

    public function __construct(array $overrides = []) {
        $this->flags = $this->defaults;
        $this->applyOverrides($overrides);
    }

    private function applyOverrides(array $overrides): void {
        foreach ($overrides as $key => $value) {
            $this->setNestedValue($this->flags, $key, $value);
        }
    }

    private function setNestedValue(array &$target, string $path, $value): void {
        $keys = explode('.', $path);
        $current = &$target;
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            if (!isset($current[$key]) || !is_array($current[$key])) {
                $current[$key] = [];
            }
            $current = &$current[$key];
        }
        $current = $value;
    }

    public function get(string $key, $default = null) {
        $keys = explode('.', $key);
        $current = $this->flags;
        foreach ($keys as $k) {
            if (!is_array($current) || !array_key_exists($k, $current)) {
                return $default;
            }
            $current = $current[$k];
        }
        return $current;
    }

    public function toArray(): array {
        return $this->flags;
    }
}

class ImageProcessor {
    private $flags;
    private $pipeline = [];

    public function __construct(FeatureFlags $flags) {
        $this->flags = $flags;
    }

    public function addStep(string $name, callable $handler): void {
        $this->pipeline[$name] = $handler;
    }

    public function process(string $inputPath, string $outputPath): array {
        $context = [
            'input' => $inputPath,
            'output' => $outputPath,
            'metadata' => [],
            'errors' => []
        ];

        foreach ($this->pipeline as $name => $handler) {
            if ($this->isStepEnabled($name)) {
                $context = $handler($context, $this->flags);
                if (!empty($context['errors'])) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        return $context;
    }

    private function isStepEnabled(string $step): bool {
        return (bool) $this->flags->get("{$step}_enabled", true);
    }
}

class ProcessorFactory {
    public static function createFromRequest(array $requestParams): ImageProcessor {
        $flagOverrides = [];

        if (isset($requestParams['config'])) {
            $config = $requestParams['config'];
            if (is_array($config)) {
                foreach ($config as $path => $val) {
                    $flagOverrides[$path] = $val;
                }
            }
        }

        $flags = new FeatureFlags($flagOverrides);
        $processor = new ImageProcessor($flags);

        $processor->addStep('validate', function($ctx, $flags) {
            $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($ctx['input'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
            $allowed = $flags->get('allowed_formats', ['jpg', 'png']);
            if (is_array($allowed) && !in_array($ext, $allowed)) {
                $ctx['errors'][] = 'Format not allowed: ' . $ext;
            }
            return $ctx;
        });

        $processor->addStep('resize', function($ctx, $flags) {
            $maxW = (int) $flags->get('max_width', 1920);
            $maxH = (int) $flags->get('max_height', 1080);
            $ctx['metadata']['resized_to'] = "{$maxW}x{$maxH}";
            return $ctx;
        });

        $processor->addStep('watermark', function($ctx, $flags) {
            $template = $flags->get('watermark_template', 'default');
            $ctx['metadata']['watermark'] = $template;
            return $ctx;
        });

        $processor->addStep('export', function($ctx, $flags) {
            $quality = (int) $flags->get('quality', 85);
            $outputCmd = $flags->get('export_command', null);
            if ($outputCmd !== null) {
                exec($outputCmd . ' ' . escapeshellarg($ctx['output']));
            } else {
                $ctx['metadata']['quality'] = $quality;
                $ctx['metadata']['exported'] = true;
            }
            return $ctx;
        });

        return $processor;
    }
}

// Entry point - handles incoming image processing requests
$requestParams = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?? [];
$inputFile = $requestParams['file'] ?? '/tmp/input.jpg';
$outputFile = '/tmp/output_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.jpg';

$processor = ProcessorFactory::createFromRequest($requestParams);
$result = $processor->process($inputFile, $outputFile);

header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo json_encode($result);
